summary: P01 V2.47.132 successful favicon provider-cache generation refresh. Production readback after V2.47.131 proved Postman rendered a real cached SVG image (not text fallback) and that the stored Production asset differed from the current valid Favicon.im asset. Revolut Business likewise reported effective cacheStatus=success while showing the old letter-like image. Root cause: historical successful Favicon.im caches had no resolver-generation provenance, so g2 could recover failed/fallback rows but could not invalidate old successful provider assets. V2.47.132 keeps the existing g2 resolver identity, treats provider-sourced success rows without the g2 marker as effective stale once, persists attempted generation provenance on successful saves, keeps direct-site successes untouched, and expands admin icon diagnostics with source/mime/size/dimensions/fetched/current-generation fields. Provider architecture, SVG security rules, schema/data model, updater mechanism and Production remain unchanged. Exact focused candidate proof preserves V2.47.127 reliability, V2.47.128 recovery queue, V2.47.130 provider-generation behavior, V2.47.131 stale-success self-heal and adds V2.47.132 successful-generation refresh coverage. Production remains OWNER manual.
